records.question: Revenue by product category
records.sql: WITH category_revenue AS (SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue FROM order_items_safe AS oi JOIN products_safe AS p ON oi.product_id = p.id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT * FROM category_revenue LIMIT 500

records.question: Average order value by customer country
records.sql: SELECT c.country, ROUND(AVG(o.total), 2) AS average_order_value FROM customers_safe AS c JOIN orders_safe AS o ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.status <> 'refunded' GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY c.country LIMIT 500
assumptions: Excluding cancelled and refunded orders to focus on valid transactions
records.gold_sql: SELECT c.country, AVG(o.total) FROM orders_safe o JOIN customers_safe c ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.country
records.detail: gold: 8 rows x 2 cols, got: 8 rows x 2 cols

records.question: Revenue by region for the Electronics category
records.sql: WITH electronics_revenue AS (SELECT o.region, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue FROM order_items_safe AS oi JOIN products_safe AS p ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN orders_safe AS o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE p.category = 'Electronics' GROUP BY o.region) SELECT region, revenue, ROUND(revenue / SUM(revenue) OVER (), 2) AS revenue_share FROM electronics_revenue ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 500
assumptions: Revenue is calculated as SUM(quantity * unit_price) for Electronics category items only

records.question: How many orders were placed in the second half of 2025?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders_in_second_half_2025 FROM orders_safe WHERE YEAR(order_date) = 2025 AND MONTH(order_date) BETWEEN 7 AND 12 LIMIT 500
